L6763@P142: Base of index: July 2003 = 100.00.
L6764@P142: Airfare Indices are not adjusted by ABS Consumer Price Index.
L6765@P142: * From the middle of February 2015, Qantas Airways ceased offering Full Economy fares for domestic travel.
L6766@P142: Since the Full Economy fare category was mainly made up of Qantas fares, it is no longer possible to continue
L6767@P142: producing the index for this fare category. In the future, if Full Economy fares are offered on sufficient routes,
L6768@P142: the index for this fare category could be reinstated.
L6769@P142: From November 2017, refunds of Jetstar’s Restricted Economy products (Starter with Max) for cancellations
L6770@P142: are only available in the form of vouchers. Vouchers may only be redeemed for other Jetstar products and are
L6771@P142: therefore considered by BITRE to be closer to a transfer than a full refund. This change in Jetstar’s product now
L6772@P142: places it outside BITRE’s definition of a restricted economy fare, which has resulted in a sharp increase in the
L6773@P142: restricted economy index for November 2017.
L6774@P142: Fares have been impacted by travel restrictions, demand and changes in service levels during the COVID-19
L6775@P142: pandemic. Business class fares collected may not include normal entitlements like meals and lounge.
L6776@P142: Virgin Australia Restricted Economy fares on some routes were noticeably lower in April 2021. The Virgin
L6777@P142: Australia web site noted that complementary food would no longer be provided on Economy class fares as of
L6778@P142: 25 March 2021.
